articles.title: AFCAT 02/2026 application window closes today for Indian Air Force vacancies; apply here
articles.summary: The application window for AFCAT 02/2026, offering numerous vacancies in the Indian Air Force, is closing today. SSB aspirants aspiring to join the IAF as commissioned officers are urged to apply immediately to avoid missing this crucial opportunity. This is a direct entry path for various branches, making timely application essential for a career in defence.

articles.title: India on track for $1 trillion exports in FY27: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal affirmed the nation is on track to achieve its ambitious $1 trillion exports target by FY27. Despite global disruptions, including the West Asia crisis, Goyal expressed confidence in India's economic resilience and strategic growth initiatives. This highlights India's focus on bolstering its global trade position and fostering robust economic expansion, crucial for national development.

articles.title: Indian, Pak Army officers shake hands during a repatriation process along LoC
articles.summary: The Indian Army repatriated Pakistani national Asad Khan, apprehended last week near the Line of Control in Kupwara. Khan had reportedly crossed the LoC inadvertently while seeking employment. This gesture of goodwill highlights the Indian Army's humane approach and adherence to humanitarian principles, even in sensitive border regions. Such actions contribute to maintaining peace and demonstrating professionalism.

articles.title: From MAGA To MIGA: The Official Merger of the United States and Israhell
articles.summary: An article fragment asserts that a 'Zion Don administration' and its associates are secretly relocating to fortified locations, accessible by submarines, while the public remains distracted by events like sports and entertainment. It suggests these preparations are for an undisclosed purpose and are not intended for public safety. The full context and specifics of these claims are not provided.
